EmulatorJS vendored runtime
Source: https://github.com/EmulatorJS/EmulatorJS/releases/tag/v4.2.3
Asset: 4.2.3.7z (sha-size 303554683 bytes), release date 2025-07-05
License: GPL-3.0 (upstream LICENSE kept at ../LICENSE)

Included (runtime-required only):
  data/loader.js            bootstrap; loads emulator.min.js/.css from EJS_pathtodata
  data/emulator.min.js      frontend bundle
  data/emulator.min.css     frontend styles
  data/compression/*        client-side archive workers: extractzip.js (zip),
                            extract7z.js (7z), libunrar.js + libunrar.wasm (rar)
  data/cores/<core>-*.data  fceumm (NES), gambatte (GB/GBC), snes9x (SNES),
                            mgba (GBA); all four build variants per core
                            (-wasm, -legacy-wasm, -thread-wasm, -thread-legacy-wasm)
  data/cores/reports/*.json per-core report JSON (core caching + WebGL2 default)

Deliberately excluded (verified unused at runtime by reading v4.2.3 source):
  data/src/*                unminified dev sources bundled inside emulator.min.js
  data/localization/*       localization() uses inline langJson config only;
                            no localization/*.json fetch exists
  data/emulator.css         unminified stylesheet fallback
  data/cores/cores.json     build tooling only; runtime fetches reports/<core>.json
  other ~50 cores           not needed for NES/GB/GBC/SNES/GBA

Local patch applied to data/emulator.min.js:
  The constructor guard calling checkForUpdates()
    (this.debug||window.location&&["localhost","127.0.0.1"].includes(location.hostname))&&this.checkForUpdates()
  was replaced by
    !1&&this.checkForUpdates()
  Reason: checkForUpdates() fetches https://cdn.emulatorjs.org/stable/data/version.json
  whenever the page is served from localhost/127.0.0.1 (which includes the bundled
  START-SERVER offline mode), violating the project zero-external-request directive.
  The function body remains but is now unreachable. Re-apply after any upgrade.

External-request audit of remaining upstream code:
  cdn.emulatorjs.org/<ver>/data/ core failsafe: reached only when a local core
    file 404s; all four variants of every needed core are vendored.
  netplay.emulatorjs.org: requires EJS_DEBUG_XX && EJS_EXPERIMENTAL_NETPLAY.
  Everything else is comments/UI strings/svg xmlns identifiers.
